message: Projects and generated tasks can now start with a priority, difficulty and time estimate, so they stop showing up in Backfill. Set them under New task defaults in a project's editor ("No priority" counts as an answer), or under Task defaults on each automation in Settings. A project can also fill in its existing tasks in one tap. In Backfill, a checkbox on the card applies your next answer to every task in the same project or automation. There's also a Difficulty default for all new tasks when rewards are on.
